title: Lossless Context Handoff detached envelope payload v0.1
description: A detached frame or Bundle envelope contains one direct role-specific payload. Transport framing supplies opaque ID, expected type, byte length, and raw digest; this schema does not invent a second wrapper.
$comment: Detached payloads are always post-seal and excluded from the T0 control and Bundle Manifest roots. Frame or INDEX metadata is routing data only and never proves issuer trust or a positive result.
